newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian April retail sales up 1.8 pct mo/mo.
newsitem.headline: Croatian April retail sales up 1.8 pct mo/mo.

text.p: Croatian retail sales rose 1.8 percent in April after a 16.8 percent surge in March, the State Bureau of Statistics reported on Wednesday.
April sales were put at 27.2 percent higher than the same month last year, bringing sales for the first four months to 30.9 percent up on the same period of 1996.
At the same time stocks grew at a faster rate of 3.7 percent month-on-month, making the annual increase 15.2 percent.
Some 500 leading retailers, representing about the half of the total sector, forecast a 3.8 percent rise of sales in May.
Turnover is calculated in current prices. It rose 0.1 percent in April on a monthly basis and 2.9 percent year on year. -- Davor Huic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
